# Vježba 1 — Uvod u mehaniku fluida {.unnumbered}

Pascalov zakon i Newtonov zakon viskoznosti uvode dva temeljna učinka u mehanici fluida: prijenos tlaka u mirujućem fluidu i unutarnje trenje pri relativnom gibanju njegovih slojeva.

### Teorijski uvod

Mehanika fluida proučava ponašanje tekućina i plinova. Za razliku od krutih tijela, fluidi nemaju stalan oblik i pod djelovanjem tangencijalnog naprezanja neprestano se deformiraju. U ovoj se vježbi uvode dva osnovna zakona na kojima počiva velik dio kasnijih proračuna.

1. **Pascalov zakon:** Tlak u točki mirujućeg fluida jednak je u svim smjerovima. Promjena tlaka nametnuta zatvorenom fluidu prenosi se kroz cijeli fluid; za idealizirani hidraulički sustav s klipovima na istoj visini vrijedi

   $$p=\frac{F_1}{A_1},\qquad F_2=pA_2,\qquad \frac{F_2}{F_1}=\frac{A_2}{A_1}.$$

   Ako klipovi nisu na istoj visini, treba uključiti i hidrostatsku razliku tlaka.
2. **Newtonov zakon viskoznosti:** Opisuje unutarnje trenje u Newtonskom fluidu. Za Couetteov tok bez gradijenta tlaka vrijedi

   $$u(y)=U\frac{y}{\delta},\qquad \left|\tau\right|=\mu\left|\frac{du}{dy}\right|=\mu\frac{U}{\delta}.$$

   Smično naprezanje stoga raste s brzinom pomične ploče $U$ i dinamičkom viskoznošću $\mu$, a smanjuje se s povećanjem zračnosti $\delta$.

Interaktivni prikaz povezuje te relacije s raspodjelom tlaka, profilom brzine i smičnim naprezanjem.

```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const canvas = $('v1-intro-canvas');
  const ctx = canvas?.getContext('2d');
  const controls = {
    force: $('v1-pascal-force'), ratio: $('v1-pascal-ratio'),
    speed: $('v1-newton-speed'), mu: $('v1-newton-mu')
  };
  if (!ctx || Object.values(controls).some((element) => !element)) return;

  let tab = 'pascal';
  const area1 = 12 / 10000;
  const gap = 0.025;
  const setText = (id, value) => { const element = $(id); if (element) element.textContent = value; };

  function values() {
    const force = Number(controls.force.value);
    const ratio = Number(controls.ratio.value);
    const speed = Number(controls.speed.value);
    const mu = Number(controls.mu.value);
    return { force, ratio, speed, mu, pressure: force / area1, output: force * ratio, gradient: speed / gap, tau: mu * speed / gap };
  }

  function update() {
    const v = values();
    setText('v1-pascal-force-val', v.force.toFixed(0));
    setText('v1-pascal-ratio-val', v.ratio.toFixed(1));
    setText('v1-pascal-pressure', (v.pressure / 1e6).toFixed(2));
    setText('v1-pascal-output', v.output.toFixed(0));
    setText('v1-newton-speed-val', v.speed.toFixed(2));
    setText('v1-newton-mu-val', v.mu.toFixed(2));
    setText('v1-newton-gradient', v.gradient.toFixed(1));
    setText('v1-newton-tau', v.tau.toFixed(1));
    $('v1-pascal-explainer').textContent = `Tlak je jednak u cijelom zatvorenom ulju. S omjerom površina ${v.ratio.toFixed(1)} izlazna sila iznosi ${v.output.toFixed(0)} N.`;
    $('v1-newton-explainer').textContent = `Za μ = ${v.mu.toFixed(2)} Pa·s i gradijent ${v.gradient.toFixed(1)} s⁻¹ smično naprezanje iznosi ${v.tau.toFixed(1)} Pa.`;
    $('v1-scene-caption').innerHTML = tab === 'pascal'
      ? 'Tlak se prenosi jednak u svim smjerovima; veća površina daje veću silu <strong>F₂</strong>.'
      : 'Brzina raste od nepomične donje do pomične gornje ploče; <strong>τ = μ·dv/dy</strong>.';
    if (tab === 'pascal') drawPascal(v); else drawNewton(v);
  }

  function arrow(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, label = '') {
    const angle = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
    ctx.strokeStyle = ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1, y1); ctx.lineTo(x2, y2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x2, y2); ctx.lineTo(x2 - 10 * Math.cos(angle - .5), y2 - 10 * Math.sin(angle - .5)); ctx.lineTo(x2 - 10 * Math.cos(angle + .5), y2 - 10 * Math.sin(angle + .5)); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    if (label) { ctx.font = '700 13px Inter, sans-serif'; ctx.fillText(label, x2 + 8, y2 - 7); }
  }

  function drawPascal(v) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fbff'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 520, 360);
    const pulse = 12, left = 94, right = 382, base = 300, top = 112, rw = 52 + v.ratio * 11;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(37,99,235,.30)'; ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(left - 26, top + 62); ctx.lineTo(left - 26, base); ctx.lineTo(right + rw / 2, base); ctx.lineTo(right + rw / 2, top + 34); ctx.lineTo(right - rw / 2, top + 34); ctx.lineTo(right - rw / 2, 242); ctx.lineTo(left + 26, 242); ctx.lineTo(left + 26, top + 62); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#334155'; ctx.fillRect(left - 22, top + 76 + pulse, 44, 14); ctx.fillRect(right - rw / 2 + 4, top + 46 - pulse / v.ratio, rw - 8, 14);
    arrow(left, top + 10, left, top + 68 + pulse, '#2563eb', 'F₁'); arrow(right, top + 64, right, top - 6, '#0f766e', 'F₂');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.font = '700 14px Inter, sans-serif'; ctx.fillText(`p = ${(v.pressure / 1e6).toFixed(2)} MPa`, 20, 30); ctx.fillText(`F₂ = ${v.output.toFixed(0)} N`, 330, 72);
    ctx.font = '13px Inter, sans-serif'; ctx.fillStyle = '#475569'; ctx.fillText('A₁ = 12 cm²', 48, 332); ctx.fillText(`A₂ = ${(12 * v.ratio).toFixed(0)} cm²`, 340, 332);
  }

  function drawNewton(v) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fffaf5'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 520, 360);
    const x = 65, y = 85, w = 315, h = 190;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(251,146,60,.22)'; ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = '#1f2937'; ctx.fillRect(x, y - 19, w, 17); ctx.fillStyle = '#475569'; ctx.fillRect(x, y + h, w, 15);
    for (let i = 0; i <= 6; i++) { const t = i / 6, yy = y + h - t * h, length = 28 + t * v.speed * 70; arrow(x + 25, yy, x + 25 + length, yy, `hsl(${205 - t * 42},78%,48%)`, i === 6 ? 'v' : ''); }
    const ratio = Math.min(v.tau / 55, 1); ctx.fillStyle = '#fee2e2'; ctx.fillRect(435, 92, 42, 180); ctx.fillStyle = '#dc2626'; ctx.fillRect(435, 92 + (1 - ratio) * 180, 42, ratio * 180);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7f1d1d'; ctx.font = '700 14px Inter, sans-serif'; ctx.fillText('τ', 449, 80); ctx.fillText(`${v.tau.toFixed(1)} Pa`, 423, 294); ctx.fillStyle = '#9a3412'; ctx.font = '13px Inter, sans-serif'; ctx.fillText(`dv/dy = ${v.gradient.toFixed(1)} s⁻¹`, 208, 52); ctx.fillText(`μ = ${v.mu.toFixed(2)} Pa·s`, 208, 72);
  }

  function setTab(next) {
    tab = next; $('v1-pascal-panel').style.display = next === 'pascal' ? 'flex' : 'none'; $('v1-newton-panel').style.display = next === 'newton' ? 'flex' : 'none';
    $('btn-pascal').style.background = next === 'pascal' ? '#2563eb' : '#e2e8f0'; $('btn-pascal').style.color = next === 'pascal' ? '#fff' : '#475569'; $('btn-pascal').setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(next === 'pascal'));
    $('btn-newton').style.background = next === 'newton' ? '#ea580c' : '#e2e8f0'; $('btn-newton').style.color = next === 'newton' ? '#fff' : '#475569'; $('btn-newton').setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(next === 'newton')); update();
  }
  $('btn-pascal').addEventListener('click', () => setTab('pascal')); $('btn-newton').addEventListener('click', () => setTab('newton'));
  Object.values(controls).forEach((control) => control.addEventListener('input', update)); setTab('pascal');
})();
</script>
```
```{=html}
<div class="mf1-note-grid">
    <div class="mf1-kriterij">
        <h4>Kriterij primjene</h4>
        <ul>
            <li>Pascalov zakon primjenjuje se na fluid u mirovanju kada se određuje prijenos tlaka ili sile kroz zatvoreni sustav.</li>
            <li>Newtonov zakon viskoznosti primjenjuje se kada gradijent brzine treba povezati s tangencijalnim naprezanjem.</li>
        </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="mf1-warning">
        <h4>Česta pogreška</h4>
        <p>Tlak i silu treba razlikovati: tlak se prenosi kroz fluid, dok sila ovisi o površini na koju tlak djeluje.</p>
    </div>
</div>
```


<hr class="zadatak-sep">

### Zadatak 1 — Težina klipa i manometarski tlak {.unnumbered}

(2500 SPFM – 2.53) Za sustav na slici potrebno je odrediti težinu klipa kada manometarsko
očitanje tlaka iznosi 70,0 kPa. U sustavnu se nalazi ulje gustoće $\rho = 860$ kg/m³.
Klip je promjera $d_k = 1$ m.

<div class="zadano-grid">
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Zadano</span>
<span class="zadano-text">$p_m = 70{,}0\ \text{kPa}$, $\rho = 860\ \text{kg/m}^3$, $d_k = 1\ \text{m}$, $h = 1\ \text{m}$</span>
</div>
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Odrediti</span>
<span class="zadano-text">a) $G$; b) visina klipa $h_k$ za $\rho_{Fe} = 7870\ \text{kg/m}^3$</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="rjesenje-label">Rješenje</div>

1. **Površina klipa:** $A_k = \pi d_k^2/4 = \pi \cdot 1^2/4 = 0{,}785\ \text{m}^2$
2. **Tlak pod klipom** (manometar mjeri na visini $h$ iznad dna, pa se dodaje hidrostatski stupac):
$$p_k = p_m + \rho g h = 70\,000 + 860 \cdot 9{,}81 \cdot 1 = 78\,437\ \text{Pa}$$
3. **Težina klipa:**
$$G = p_k \cdot A_k = 78\,437 \cdot 0{,}785 = 61\,603\ \text{N}$$
4. **Visina klipa (b):** $m_k = G/g = 6280\ \text{kg}$; $\quad h_k = m_k/(A_k \cdot \rho_{Fe}) = 6280/(0{,}785 \cdot 7870) = 1{,}01\ \text{m}$

````{=html}
            <div style="font-size: 0.78rem; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 8px;">Što je instrument više, to mu dođe manji tlak.</div>
            <input type="range" id="z2-h" min="0" max="3" step="0.1" value="1.0" style="width: 100%; accent-color: #0f766e;">

        </div>

        <div style="background: #ffffff; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #fed7aa; border-radius: 16px;">

            <label style="display: block; font-weight: 700; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 6px;">Dodatni teret: <span id="z2-v-extra" style="color: #ea580c;">0</span> kN</label>
            <div style="font-size: 0.78rem; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 8px;">Veći teret povećava tlak pod klipom pₖ = G/A.</div>

<div class="fizikalni-uvid">
Manometar ne očitava direktno tlak pod klipom. On očitava tlak na svojoj visini, pa je zato potrebno od tlaka pod klipom oduzeti hidrostatski pad kroz stupac ulja do mjesta mjerenja.
</div>

<script>
(function() {
    function clamp(value, min, max) {
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
    }

    const rhoS = document.getElementById('z2-rho');
    if (!rhoS) return;
    const hS = document.getElementById('z2-h');
    const extraS = document.getElementById('z2-extra');
    const pistonEl = document.getElementById('z2-piston');
    const weightEl = document.getElementById('z2-weight');
    const weightTextEl = document.getElementById('z2-weight-text');
    const rodEl = document.getElementById('z2-rod');
    const needleEl = document.getElementById('z2-needle');
    const pipeEl = document.getElementById('z2-pipe');
    const portEl = document.getElementById('z2-port');
    const gaugeGroupEl = document.getElementById('z2-gauge-group');
    const hGuideEl = document.getElementById('z2-h-guide');
    const hGuideTopEl = document.getElementById('z2-h-guide-top');
    const hGuideBottomEl = document.getElementById('z2-h-guide-bottom');
    const hLabelEl = document.getElementById('z2-h-label');
    const oilStop1 = document.getElementById('z2-oil-stop1');
    const oilStop2 = document.getElementById('z2-oil-stop2');

    function setText(id, value) {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.textContent = value;
    }

    function getValues() {
        const rho = parseFloat(rhoS.value);
        const h = parseFloat(hS.value);
        const extraLoad = parseFloat(extraS.value) * 1000;
        const Ak = Math.PI / 4;
        const g = 9.81;
        const baseG = 61603;
        const currentG = baseG + extraLoad;
        const pistonPressure = currentG / Ak / 1000;
        const hydroDrop = rho * g * h / 1000;
        const pm = pistonPressure - hydroDrop;

        return { rho, h, extraLoad, Ak, g, currentG, pistonPressure, hydroDrop, pm };
    }

    function update() {
        const values = getValues();

        setText('z2-v-rho', values.rho.toFixed(0));
        setText('z2-v-h', values.h.toFixed(1));
        setText('z2-v-extra', (values.extraLoad / 1000).toFixed(0));
        setText('z2-res-piston', values.pistonPressure.toFixed(1));
        setText('z2-res-hydro', values.hydroDrop.toFixed(1));
        setText('z2-res-pm', values.pm.toFixed(1));
        setText('z2-res-pm-top', values.pm.toFixed(1));
        setText('z2-res-g', (values.currentG / 1000).toFixed(1));
        setText('z2-hero-piston', values.pistonPressure.toFixed(1));
        setText('z2-hero-hydro', values.hydroDrop.toFixed(1));
        setText('z2-hero-pm', values.pm.toFixed(1));
        setText('z2-stage-pk', values.pistonPressure.toFixed(1));
        setText('z2-stage-drop', values.hydroDrop.toFixed(1));
        setText('z2-stage-pm', values.pm.toFixed(1));
        setText('z2-eq-vals', `${values.pm.toFixed(1)} kPa = ${values.pistonPressure.toFixed(1)} kPa - ${values.hydroDrop.toFixed(1)} kPa`);
        setText('z2-explainer', `Klip trenutačno stvara ${values.pistonPressure.toFixed(1)} kPa na dnu cilindra, ali se do manometra izgubi ${values.hydroDrop.toFixed(1)} kPa zbog penjanja kroz stupac ulja visine ${values.h.toFixed(1)} m. Zato instrument pokazuje ${values.pm.toFixed(1)} kPa, a ne puni tlak pod klipom.`);

        const pRatio = Math.min(values.pistonPressure / 190, 1);
        const hRatio = Math.min(values.hydroDrop / 30, 1);
        const mRatio = Math.min(values.pm / 180, 1);
        document.getElementById('z2-bar-p').style.width = `${(pRatio * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
        document.getElementById('z2-bar-h').style.width = `${(hRatio * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
        document.getElementById('z2-bar-m').style.width = `${(mRatio * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;

        const pistonDrop = Math.min((values.currentG / 1000) * 0.08, 14);
        pistonEl.setAttribute('y', (92 + pistonDrop).toFixed(1));
        weightEl.setAttribute('y', (12 + pistonDrop).toFixed(1));
        weightTextEl.setAttribute('y', (37 + pistonDrop).toFixed(1));
        rodEl.setAttribute('y1', (52 + pistonDrop).toFixed(1));
        rodEl.setAttribute('y2', (92 + pistonDrop).toFixed(1));
        weightTextEl.textContent = `${(values.currentG / 1000).toFixed(1)} kN`;

        const tapY = 344 - values.h * 62;
        portEl.setAttribute('cy', tapY.toFixed(1));
        pipeEl.setAttribute('d', `M308 ${tapY.toFixed(1)} L506 ${tapY.toFixed(1)}`);
        hGuideEl.setAttribute('d', `M350 344 L350 ${tapY.toFixed(1)}`);
        hGuideTopEl.setAttribute('y1', tapY.toFixed(1));
        hGuideTopEl.setAttribute('y2', tapY.toFixed(1));
        hGuideBottomEl.setAttribute('y1', '344');
        hGuideBottomEl.setAttribute('y2', '344');
        hLabelEl.setAttribute('y', ((344 + tapY) / 2 + 5).toFixed(1));
        hLabelEl.textContent = `h = ${values.h.toFixed(1)} m`;
        gaugeGroupEl.setAttribute('transform', `translate(0 ${(tapY - 282).toFixed(1)})`);

        const angle = -125 + clamp(values.pm, 0, 180) / 180 * 250;
        needleEl.setAttribute('transform', `rotate(${angle.toFixed(2)} 584 282)`);

        const cTop = 0.20 + (values.rho - 700) / 300 * 0.24;
        const cBot = 0.40 + (values.rho - 700) / 300 * 0.26;
        oilStop1.setAttribute('stop-opacity', cTop.toFixed(3));
        oilStop2.setAttribute('stop-opacity', cBot.toFixed(3));
    }

    [rhoS, hS, extraS].forEach((slider) => slider.addEventListener('input', update));
    update();
})();
</script>
````

<hr class="zadatak-sep">

### Zadatak 2 — Modul stlačivosti tekućine {.unnumbered}

(2500 SPFM – 1.25) Tekućina stlačena u cilindru zauzima početni volumen od 1000 cm³ pri
tlaku od 1 MPa, dok pri tlaku od 2 MPa zauzima volumen od 995 cm³. Potrebno je odrediti
modul stlačivosti tekućine.

<div class="zadano-grid">
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Zadano</span>
<span class="zadano-text">$V_1 = 1000\ \text{cm}^3$, $p_1 = 1\ \text{MPa}$, $V_2 = 995\ \text{cm}^3$, $p_2 = 2\ \text{MPa}$</span>
</div>
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Odrediti</span>
<span class="zadano-text">volumenski modul stlačivosti $K$</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="rjesenje-label">Rješenje</div>

1. **Definicija:** $K=-V\,dp/dV$. Za mali konačni interval ovdje koristimo sekantnu aproksimaciju $K\approx-\Delta p/(\Delta V/V_1)$.
2. **Uvrštavanje:**
$$K \approx -\frac{\Delta p}{\Delta V/V_1} = -\frac{(2-1)\cdot 10^6}{(995-1000)/1000} = 200\ \mathrm{MPa}$$

````{=html}
                <div style="display: grid; gap: 10px;">
                    <div>
                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.8rem; margin-bottom: 4px;"><span style="color: #2563eb;">Voda</span><strong id="z4-val-liquid" style="color: #1d4ed8;">0.04%</strong></div>
                        <div style="height: 10px; background: #e2e8f0; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden;"><div id="z4-bar-liquid" style="width: 0%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #60a5fa, #2563eb);"></div></div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.8rem; margin-bottom: 4px;"><span style="color: #dc2626;">Zrak</span><strong id="z4-val-gas" style="color: #b91c1c;">90%</strong></div>
                        <div style="height: 10px; background: #e2e8f0; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden;"><div id="z4-bar-gas" style="width: 0%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fca5a5, #ef4444);"></div></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 10px;">
                <div style="background: #eff6ff; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe; border-radius: 14px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 0.7rem; color: #1d4ed8; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 4px;">Volumen vode</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 800; color: #1d4ed8;"><span id="z4-vol-liquid">999.6</span> cm³</div>
                </div>
                <div style="background: #fff5f5; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #fecaca; border-radius: 14px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 0.7rem; color: #b91c1c; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 4px;">Volumen zraka</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 800; color: #b91c1c;"><span id="z4-vol-gas">100.0</span> cm³</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div style="padding: 14px 16px; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 16px; color: #334155;">
                <div style="font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a; margin-bottom: 6px;">Fizikalno tumačenje</div>
                <p id="z4-explainer" style="margin: 0; font-size: 0.84rem; line-height: 1.55;"></p>
            </div>

            <div style="background:#ffffff; padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:16px;">
                <div style="font-size:0.72rem; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; color:#64748b; margin-bottom:8px;">Usporedba volumenskog modula K</div>
                <div style="font-size:0.8rem; color:#1d4ed8; margin-bottom:3px;">Voda ~ 2000 MPa</div>
                <div style="height:10px; background:#e2e8f0; border-radius:999px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:8px;"><div style="height:100%; width:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#60a5fa,#1d4ed8);"></div></div>
                <div style="font-size:0.8rem; color:#b91c1c; margin-bottom:3px;">Zrak ~ 0.1 MPa</div>
                <div style="height:10px; background:#e2e8f0; border-radius:999px; overflow:hidden;"><div style="height:100%; width:6%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fca5a5,#ef4444);"></div></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="fizikalni-uvid">
Volumenski modul određuje promjenu volumena pri promjeni tlaka. Zato je pomak klipa pri istoj promjeni tlaka kod tekućine znatno manji nego kod plina.
</div>

<script>
(function() {
    const z4c = document.getElementById('z4-canvas');
    if (!z4c) return;
    const z4ctx = z4c.getContext('2d');
    const z4pS = document.getElementById('z4-p');
    const Z4_BASE_W = 720;
    const Z4_BASE_H = 420;

    let z4Ratio = 1;
    let z4ScaleX = 1;
    let z4ScaleY = 1;
    let z4State = { p: 1, liquidCompression: 0, gasCompression: 0 };

    function createParticles(count, xMin, xMax, yMin, yMax, speed) {
        return Array.from({ length: count }, () => ({
            x: xMin + Math.random() * (xMax - xMin),
            y: yMin + Math.random() * (yMax - yMin),
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed
        }));
    }

    const liquidParticles = createParticles(86, 72, 280, 132, 316, 0.65);
    const gasParticles = createParticles(50, 438, 648, 114, 320, 3.2);

    function clamp(value, min, max) {
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
    }

    function traceRoundedRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
        const rr = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
        z4ctx.beginPath();
        z4ctx.moveTo(x + rr, y);
        z4ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, rr);
        z4ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, rr);
        z4ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, rr);
        z4ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, rr);
        z4ctx.closePath();
    }

    function resizeZ4Canvas() {
        const rect = z4c.getBoundingClientRect();
        const displayWidth = Math.max(Math.round(rect.width) || Z4_BASE_W, 320);
        const displayHeight = Math.max(Math.round(rect.height) || Z4_BASE_H, 260);
        z4Ratio = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);

        const pixelWidth = Math.max(1, Math.round(displayWidth * z4Ratio));
        const pixelHeight = Math.max(1, Math.round(displayHeight * z4Ratio));

        if (z4c.width !== pixelWidth || z4c.height !== pixelHeight) {
            z4c.width = pixelWidth;
            z4c.height = pixelHeight;
        }

        z4ScaleX = displayWidth / Z4_BASE_W;
        z4ScaleY = displayHeight / Z4_BASE_H;
        z4ctx.setTransform(z4ScaleX * z4Ratio, 0, 0, z4ScaleY * z4Ratio, 0, 0);
        z4ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
        z4ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        z4ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    }

    function syncZ4State() {
        const p = parseFloat(z4pS.value);
        document.getElementById('z4-v-p').textContent = p.toFixed(1);
        document.getElementById('z4-v-p-side').textContent = p.toFixed(1);
        document.getElementById('z4-dp').textContent = (p - 1).toFixed(1);

        const dP = Math.max(p - 1, 0);
        const liquidCompression = Math.max(0, (dP / 2000) * 100);
        const gasCompression = Math.min((1 - 1 / Math.max(p, 1)) * 100, 90);
        const liquidVolume = 1000 * (1 - liquidCompression / 100);
        const gasVolume = 1000 * (1 - gasCompression / 100);

        document.getElementById('z4-bar-liquid').style.width = `${Math.min(liquidCompression * 300, 100)}%`;
        document.getElementById('z4-val-liquid').textContent = `${liquidCompression.toFixed(2)}%`;
        document.getElementById('z4-bar-gas').style.width = `${gasCompression.toFixed(1)}%`;
        document.getElementById('z4-val-gas').textContent = `${gasCompression.toFixed(1)}%`;
        document.getElementById('z4-vol-liquid').textContent = liquidVolume.toFixed(1);
        document.getElementById('z4-vol-gas').textContent = gasVolume.toFixed(1);
        document.getElementById('z4-explainer').textContent = `Na ${p.toFixed(0)} MPa voda izgubi tek ${liquidCompression.toFixed(2)}% volumena, pa njezin klip gotovo da se ne pomakne. Plin pri istom opterećenju izgubi oko ${gasCompression.toFixed(1)}% volumena, zato se ondje vidi veliko skupljanje i mnogo veća promjena rasporeda čestica.`;

        z4State = { p, liquidCompression, gasCompression };
    }

    function drawZ4() {
        resizeZ4Canvas();
        z4ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
        z4ctx.clearRect(0, 0, z4c.width, z4c.height);
        z4ctx.setTransform(z4ScaleX * z4Ratio, 0, 0, z4ScaleY * z4Ratio, 0, 0);

        const bg = z4ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, Z4_BASE_H);
        bg.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
        bg.addColorStop(1, '#edf5ff');
        z4ctx.fillStyle = bg;
        z4ctx.fillRect(0, 0, Z4_BASE_W, Z4_BASE_H);

        z4ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12)';
        z4ctx.fillRect(350, 40, 2, 320);

        const left = { x: 52, y: 86, w: 248, h: 250 };
        const right = { x: 420, y: 86, w: 248, h: 250 };
        const liqTop = left.y + z4State.liquidCompression * 28;
        const gasTop = right.y + z4State.gasCompression * 2.25;

        drawChamber(left, liqTop, '#93c5fd', '#2563eb', '#1d4ed8', 'Tekućina', 'velik K, mali ΔV');
        drawChamber(right, gasTop, '#fda4af', '#ef4444', '#b91c1c', 'Plin', 'mali K, velik ΔV');

        drawParticles(liquidParticles, left, liqTop, 'rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.88)', 4.2);
        drawParticles(gasParticles, right, gasTop, 'rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.82)', 4.2);

        drawPressureArrow(left.x + left.w / 2, 26, left.x + left.w / 2, liqTop - 10, '#2563eb', `p = ${z4State.p.toFixed(1)} MPa`);
        drawPressureArrow(right.x + right.w / 2, 26, right.x + right.w / 2, gasTop - 10, '#dc2626', `p = ${z4State.p.toFixed(1)} MPa`);

        drawLabelPill(left.x + 18, left.y + 18, `ΔV/V ≈ ${z4State.liquidCompression.toFixed(2)}%`, '#dbeafe', '#1d4ed8', '#eff6ff');
        drawLabelPill(right.x + 18, right.y + 18, `ΔV/V ≈ ${z4State.gasCompression.toFixed(1)}%`, '#fecaca', '#b91c1c', '#fff1f2');

    }

    function drawChamber(box, topY, fillTop, fillBottom, accent, title, subtitle) {
        z4ctx.save();
        traceRoundedRect(box.x, box.y, box.w, box.h, 22);
        z4ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        z4ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.10)';
        z4ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
        z4ctx.fill();
        z4ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        z4ctx.strokeStyle = '#cbd5e1';
        z4ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
        z4ctx.stroke();

        z4ctx.save();
        traceRoundedRect(box.x, box.y, box.w, box.h, 22);
        z4ctx.clip();
        const fluid = z4ctx.createLinearGradient(0, topY, 0, box.y + box.h);
        fluid.addColorStop(0, fillTop);
        fluid.addColorStop(1, fillBottom);
        z4ctx.fillStyle = fluid;
        z4ctx.fillRect(box.x, topY, box.w, box.y + box.h - topY);
        z4ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)';
        z4ctx.fillRect(box.x + 10, topY + 8, box.w - 20, 10);
        z4ctx.restore();

        const pistonGrad = z4ctx.createLinearGradient(0, topY - 18, 0, topY);
        pistonGrad.addColorStop(0, '#475569');
        pistonGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1e293b');
        z4ctx.fillStyle = pistonGrad;
        traceRoundedRect(box.x - 6, topY - 18, box.w + 12, 18, 8);
        z4ctx.fill();
        z4ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18)';
        z4ctx.fillRect(box.x + 14, topY - 15, box.w - 28, 4);

        z4ctx.fillStyle = accent;
        z4ctx.font = '700 18px Inter';
        z4ctx.fillText(title, box.x + 12, box.y + box.h + 32);
        z4ctx.font = '13px Inter';
        z4ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
        z4ctx.fillText(subtitle, box.x + 12, box.y + box.h + 54);
        z4ctx.restore();
    }

    function drawParticles(particles, box, topY, fillStyle, radius) {
        const xMin = box.x + 16;
        const xMax = box.x + box.w - 16;
        const yMin = topY + 16;
        const yMax = box.y + box.h - 16;

        particles.forEach((pt) => {
            pt.x += pt.vx;
            pt.y += pt.vy;

            if (pt.x < xMin || pt.x > xMax) {
                pt.vx *= -1;
                pt.x = clamp(pt.x, xMin, xMax);
            }
            if (pt.y < yMin || pt.y > yMax) {
                pt.vy *= -1;
                pt.y = clamp(pt.y, yMin, yMax);
            }

            z4ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle;
            z4ctx.beginPath();
            z4ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            z4ctx.fill();

            z4ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.30)';
            z4ctx.beginPath();
            z4ctx.arc(pt.x - radius * 0.35, pt.y - radius * 0.35, radius * 0.34, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            z4ctx.fill();
        });
    }

    function drawPressureArrow(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, label) {
        const headlen = 13;
        const angle = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
        z4ctx.strokeStyle = color;
        z4ctx.fillStyle = color;
        z4ctx.lineWidth = 5;
        z4ctx.beginPath();
        z4ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
        z4ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
        z4ctx.stroke();
        z4ctx.beginPath();
        z4ctx.moveTo(x2, y2);
        z4ctx.lineTo(x2 - headlen * Math.cos(angle - Math.PI / 6), y2 - headlen * Math.sin(angle - Math.PI / 6));
        z4ctx.lineTo(x2 - headlen * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI / 6), y2 - headlen * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI / 6));
        z4ctx.closePath();
        z4ctx.fill();
        drawLabelPill(x1 - 58, y1 - 16, label, color, '#ffffff', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)');
    }

    function drawLabelPill(x, y, text, borderColor, textColor, fillColor) {
        z4ctx.save();
        z4ctx.font = '700 13px Inter';
        const textWidth = z4ctx.measureText(text).width;
        const width = textWidth + 22;
        traceRoundedRect(x, y, width, 24, 12);
        z4ctx.fillStyle = fillColor;
        z4ctx.strokeStyle = borderColor;
        z4ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
        z4ctx.fill();
        z4ctx.stroke();
        z4ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
        z4ctx.fillText(text, x + 11, y + 16.5);
        z4ctx.restore();
    }

    z4pS.addEventListener('input', () => {
        syncZ4State();
        drawZ4();
    });

    if (window.ResizeObserver) {
        const z4ResizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => drawZ4());
        z4ResizeObserver.observe(z4c);
    }

    syncZ4State();
    drawZ4();
})();
</script>
````


<hr class="zadatak-sep">

### Zadatak 3 — Gustoća oceana na velikim dubinama {.unnumbered}

(2500 SPFM – 1.34) Na dubini od 7 km u oceanu tlak iznosi 71,6 MPa. Gustoća na površini
iznosi $\rho_0 = 1025\ \text{kg/m}^3$, pri čemu modul stlačivosti iznosi 2,34 GPa za dotični
raspon tlaka. Potrebno je odrediti gustoću fluida na dubini od 7 km i postotak promjene
gustoće fluida između površine i dubine od 7 km.

<div class="zadano-grid">
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Zadano</span>
<span class="zadano-text">$h = 7000\ \mathrm{m}$, $p_h = 71{,}6\ \mathrm{MPa}$, $\rho_0 = 1025\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, $K = 2{,}34\ \mathrm{GPa}$</span>
</div>
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Odrediti</span>
<span class="zadano-text">$\rho_h$ i postotak promjene gustoće $\Delta\rho/\rho_0$</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="rjesenje-label">Rješenje</div>

1. **Točno za konstantan volumenski modul:** Iz $K=\rho\,dp/d\rho$ i $\Delta p=p_2-p_1$ slijedi
$$\rho_2=\rho_1\exp\left(\frac{\Delta p}{K}\right)=1025\exp\left(\frac{71{,}6\cdot10^6}{2{,}34\cdot10^9}\right)=1056{,}8\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}.$$
2. **Promjena gustoće:**
$$\frac{\Delta\rho}{\rho_1}=\exp\left(\frac{\Delta p}{K}\right)-1=3{,}11\ \%.$$

Linearna procjena $\Delta\rho/\rho_1\approx\Delta p/K$ ovdje daje $3{,}06\ \%$; bliska je, ali nije predstavljena kao egzaktan rezultat.

<hr class="widget-sep">
<div class="widget-label">Interaktivni prikaz</div>

````{=html}
<div class="mf1-lab" id="z5-advanced-widget" style="max-width: 900px; margin: 30px auto; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; padding: 25px; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
    <h4 style="text-align: center; color: #1e293b; margin-top: 0; font-weight: 700;">Zadatak 3: Gustoća fluida na dubini oceana</h4>
    <p class="widget-idea">Mijenjaš dubinu u samokonzistentnom hidrostatskom modelu s konstantnim volumenskim modulom K.</p>
    <div class="widget-equation">$\rho(z)=\frac{\rho_0}{1-\rho_0gz/K}$, $\quad p(z)=p_0-K\ln\!\left(1-\rho_0gz/K\right)$</div>
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
        <div style="flex: 1.5; min-width: 320px; position: relative; height: 350px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: #ffffff;">
            <div id="z5-ocean-bg" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #38bdf8 0%, #0369a1 50%, #082f49 100%); position: relative;">
                <!-- Oznaka položaja promatranog plovila -->
                <div id="z5-sub" style="position:absolute; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); top:10%; padding:0.14rem 0.38rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.75); border-radius:999px; background:rgba(15,23,42,0.45); color:#fff; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:700; transition:top 0.5s ease-out;">brod</div>
                <!-- Depth line -->
                <div id="z5-depth-line" style="position: absolute; width: 100%; border-top: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.3); top: 10%; transition: top 0.5s;">
                    <span style="position: absolute; right: 10px; top: -15px; font-size: 10px; color: #ffffff;"><span id="z5-v-depth-val">0</span> m</span>
                </div>
                <!-- Molecular grid (using canvas for performance) -->
                <canvas id="z5-molecules" width="400" height="350" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none;"></canvas>
                <div style="position:absolute; left:10px; bottom:10px; max-width:250px; color:#ffffff; font-size:0.78rem; line-height:1.35; background:rgba(15,23,42,.48); border-radius:8px; padding:6px 8px;">Kvalitativni prikaz povećanja gustoće — nije molekularna skala.</div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 240px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 15px;">
            <div style="background: #ffffff; padding: 15px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
                <label style="font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b;">Dubina: <span id="z5-v-depth">0</span> m</label>
                <input type="range" id="z5-depth" min="0" max="10000" step="100" value="0" style="width: 100%; accent-color: #38bdf8;">
                <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:0.72rem; color:#64748b; margin-top:3px;"><span>0</span><span>10 000</span></div>
            </div>

            <div style="background: #eff6ff; padding: 15px; border: 1px solid #0369a1;">
                <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #0369a1; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px;">PARAMETRI NA DUBINI:</div>
                <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.85rem;">
                    <div style="color: #475569;">Tlak:</div><div style="font-weight: 700; color: #1e293b;"><span id="z5-res-p">0.1</span> MPa</div>
                    <div style="color: #475569;">Gustoća:</div><div style="font-weight: 700; color: #1e293b;"><span id="z5-res-rho">1025</span> kg/m³</div>
                    <div style="color: #475569;">Porast ρ:</div><div id="z5-perc-badge" style="font-weight: 700; color: #166534;"><span id="z5-res-perc">0.00</span> %</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div style="background:#ffffff; padding:12px; border:1px solid #dbeafe; border-radius:10px;">
                <div style="font-size:0.74rem; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; color:#64748b; margin-bottom:6px;">Graf: tlak i gustoća po dubini</div>

<div class="fizikalni-uvid">
Tlak u oceanu raste s dubinom i komprimira vodu. Na 7 km dubine gustoća je vidljivo veća nego na površini uslijed modula stlačivosti.
</div>

<script>
(function() {
    const z5dS = document.getElementById('z5-depth');
    const z5sub = document.getElementById('z5-sub');
    const z5line = document.getElementById('z5-depth-line');
    const z5c = document.getElementById('z5-molecules');
    const z5ctx = z5c.getContext('2d');
    const z5chart = document.getElementById('z5-chart');
    const z5chartCtx = z5chart.getContext('2d');

    function updateZ5() {
        const d = parseFloat(z5dS.value);
        document.getElementById('z5-v-depth').innerText = d;
        document.getElementById('z5-v-depth-val').innerText = d;
        
        const rho0 = 1025;
        const g0 = 9.81;
        const K = 2.34e9;
        const p0 = 0.1e6;
        const compression = (rho0 * g0 * d) / K;
        const rho = rho0 / (1 - compression);
        const p = (p0 - K * Math.log(1 - compression)) / 1e6;
        const perc = ((rho/1025)-1)*100;
        
        document.getElementById('z5-res-p').innerText = p.toFixed(1);
        document.getElementById('z5-res-rho').innerText = rho.toFixed(1);
        document.getElementById('z5-res-perc').innerText = perc.toFixed(2);

        const yPerc = (d / 10000) * 80 + 10;
        z5sub.style.top = yPerc + "%";
        z5line.style.top = yPerc + "%";
        z5sub.innerText = d > 500 ? "podmornica" : "brod";

        const oceanTop = [56, 189, 248];
        const oceanBottom = [8, 47, 73];
        const tr = Math.min(d / 10000, 1);
        const r = Math.round(oceanTop[0] + (oceanBottom[0] - oceanTop[0]) * tr);
        const g = Math.round(oceanTop[1] + (oceanBottom[1] - oceanTop[1]) * tr);
        const b = Math.round(oceanTop[2] + (oceanBottom[2] - oceanTop[2]) * tr);
        document.getElementById('z5-ocean-bg').style.background = `linear-gradient(to bottom, rgb(${r},${g},${b}) 0%, #0369a1 50%, #082f49 100%)`;

        const badge = document.getElementById('z5-perc-badge');
        badge.style.color = perc < 1 ? '#166534' : (perc < 2 ? '#a16207' : '#b91c1c');

        // Draw molecular grid density
        z5ctx.clearRect(0,0,400,350);
        z5ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3)";
        const step = Math.max(8, 20 - (perc * 2));
        for(let x=0; x<400; x+=step) {
            for(let y=0; y<350; y+=step) {
                z5ctx.fillRect(x, y, 2, 2);
            }
        }

        drawChart(d);
    }

    function drawChart(currentDepth) {
        const c = z5chartCtx;
        const w = z5chart.width;
        const h = z5chart.height;
        c.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
        c.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        c.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

        const pArea = {l: 36, r: w - 28, t: 12, b: h - 26};
        c.strokeStyle = '#cbd5e1';
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(pArea.l, pArea.t);
        c.lineTo(pArea.l, pArea.b);
        c.lineTo(pArea.r, pArea.b);
        c.stroke();

        c.fillStyle = '#64748b';
        c.font = '12px Inter';
        c.fillText('Dubina (m)', 4, 13);
        c.fillText('p (MPa)', pArea.r - 42, 13);
        c.fillText('ρ (kg/m³)', pArea.r - 72, h - 7);

        const dMax = 10000;
        const dNow = Math.max(0, Math.min(currentDepth, dMax));
        const n = Math.max(2, Math.floor(dNow / 200));
        c.strokeStyle = '#1d4ed8';
        c.lineWidth = 2;
        c.beginPath();
        for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            const d = (i / n) * dNow;
            const compression = (1025 * 9.81 * d) / 2.34e9;
            const p = (0.1e6 - 2.34e9 * Math.log(1 - compression)) / 1e6;
            const x = pArea.l + (d / dMax) * (pArea.r - pArea.l);
            const y = pArea.b - (p / 105) * (pArea.b - pArea.t);
            if (i === 0) c.moveTo(x, y); else c.lineTo(x, y);
        }
        c.stroke();

        c.strokeStyle = '#dc2626';
        c.lineWidth = 2;
        c.beginPath();
        for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            const d = (i / n) * dNow;
            const compression = (1025 * 9.81 * d) / 2.34e9;
            const rho = 1025 / (1 - compression);
            const x = pArea.l + (d / dMax) * (pArea.r - pArea.l);
            const y = pArea.b - ((rho - 1025) / 45) * (pArea.b - pArea.t);
            if (i === 0) c.moveTo(x, y); else c.lineTo(x, y);
        }
        c.stroke();

        const cx = pArea.l + (dNow / dMax) * (pArea.r - pArea.l);
        c.strokeStyle = '#94a3b8';
        c.setLineDash([4, 4]);
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(cx, pArea.t);
        c.lineTo(cx, pArea.b);
        c.stroke();
        c.setLineDash([]);
    }
    z5dS.oninput = updateZ5; updateZ5();
})();
</script>
````

<hr class="zadatak-sep">

### Zadatak 4 — Profil brzine u cijevi {.unnumbered}

(2500 SPFM – 1.69) Voda struji kroz cijev. Profil brzine u poprečnom presjeku zadan je
izrazom $v = \left(\frac{\beta}{4\mu}\right)\!\left(\frac{d^2}{4} - r^2\right)$, pri čemu je
$v$ — brzina ovisna o polumjeru $r$, $\beta$ — konstanta, $\mu$ — viskoznost, $d$ — promjer
cijevi, $r$ — radijalna udaljenost od osi. Odrediti tangencijalno naprezanje na stjenkama
cijevi. Odrediti tangencijalno naprezanje na polumjeru $r = d/4$. Ukoliko ukupna duljina
cijevi iznosi $L$, odrediti ukupnu tangencijalnu silu na stijenkama cijevi.

<div class="zadano-grid">
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Zadano</span>
<span class="zadano-text">$v(r) = \tfrac{\beta}{4\mu}\!\left(\tfrac{d^2}{4} - r^2\right)$, duljina cijevi $L$</span>
</div>
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Odrediti</span>
<span class="zadano-text">a) $\tau_s$ pri $r = d/2$; b) $\tau_{d/4}$ pri $r = d/4$; c) ukupna tangencijalna sila $F_{\tau s}$</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="rjesenje-label">Rješenje</div>

1. **Gradijent brzine** derivacijom po $r$: $dv/dr = -\beta r/(2\mu)$
2. **Newtonov zakon** $\tau = \mu\,dv/dr$ daje opće naprezanje:
$$\tau(r) = -\frac{\beta r}{2}$$
3. **Naprezanje na stijenci** ($r = d/2$):
$$\tau_w = -\frac{\beta d}{4},\qquad |\tau_w|=\frac{\beta d}{4}$$
4. **Naprezanje na $r = d/4$:**
$$\tau_{d/4} = -\frac{\beta d}{8}$$
5. **Ukupna sila** na plaštu $A = \pi d L$:
$$F_{\tau s} = \tau_w\pi dL=-\frac{\beta d^2\pi L}{4},\qquad |F_{\tau s}|=\frac{\beta d^2\pi L}{4}$$

````{=html}
                <tr><td style="padding:6px 4px;">$\tau(r=d/2)$</td><td style="padding:6px 4px;"><span id="z6-res-tau-wall-tbl">2.50</span> Pa</td></tr>

<div class="fizikalni-uvid">
Profil pokazuje da je intenzitet smičnog naprezanja $|\tau|$ najveći na stijenci, a jednak nuli na osi cijevi.
</div>

<script>
(function() {
    const canvas = document.getElementById('z6-main-canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const muS = document.getElementById('z6-mu');
    const betaS = document.getElementById('z6-beta');
    const dS = document.getElementById('z6-d');
    const lS = document.getElementById('z6-l');
    const tooltip = document.getElementById('z6-inspect-tooltip');

    let particles = Array.from({length: 70}, () => ({
        x: Math.random(),
        y: Math.random() * 2 - 1,
        size: 1.8 + Math.random() * 1.6
    }));
    let mousePos = null;
    let dragMode = false;
    let probeYRatio = null;

    canvas.onmousemove = (e) => {
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        mousePos = { x: e.clientX - rect.left, y: e.clientY - rect.top };
        if (dragMode && probeYRatio !== null) {
            probeYRatio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, mousePos.y / rect.height));
        }
        draw();
    };
    canvas.onmouseleave = () => { mousePos = null; tooltip.style.display = 'none'; draw(); };
    canvas.onmousedown = (e) => {
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        dragMode = true;
        probeYRatio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height));
        draw();
    };
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
        dragMode = false;
    });

    function clamp(value, min, max) {
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
    }

    function panel(ctx, x, y, w, h, title, accent) {
        ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#dbeafe";
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, 16, true, true);
        ctx.fillStyle = accent;
        ctx.font = "600 13px Inter";
        ctx.fillText(title, x + 14, y + 24);
    }

    function roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r, fill, stroke) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
        ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
        ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
        ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
        ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
        ctx.closePath();
        if (fill) ctx.fill();
        if (stroke) ctx.stroke();
    }

    function drawArrow(ctx, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width = 2) {
        const headlen = 8;
        const angle = Math.atan2(y2-y1, x2-x1);
        ctx.strokeStyle = color;
        ctx.fillStyle = color;
        ctx.lineWidth = width;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
        ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x2, y2);
        ctx.lineTo(x2-headlen*Math.cos(angle-Math.PI/6), y2-headlen*Math.sin(angle-Math.PI/6));
        ctx.lineTo(x2-headlen*Math.cos(angle+Math.PI/6), y2-headlen*Math.sin(angle+Math.PI/6));
        ctx.fill();
    }

    function draw() {
        const mu = parseFloat(muS.value) / 1000;
        const beta = parseFloat(betaS.value);
        const d_mm = parseFloat(dS.value);
        const L = parseFloat(lS.value);
        const R = d_mm / 2;
        const d_m = d_mm / 1000;
        const tauWall = beta * d_m / 4;
        const tauQuarter = beta * d_m / 8;
        const v_max = (beta * d_m * d_m) / (16 * mu);
        const F_tau = tauWall * Math.PI * d_m * L;

        document.getElementById('z6-v-mu').innerText = (mu*1000).toFixed(0);
        document.getElementById('z6-v-beta').innerText = beta;
        document.getElementById('z6-v-d').innerText = d_mm;
        document.getElementById('z6-v-l').innerText = L.toFixed(1);
        document.getElementById('z6-res-tau-wall').innerText = tauWall.toFixed(2);
        document.getElementById('z6-res-tau-quarter').innerText = tauQuarter.toFixed(2);
        document.getElementById('z6-res-force-wall').innerText = F_tau.toFixed(2);
        document.getElementById('z6-res-vmax').innerText = v_max.toFixed(2);
        document.getElementById('z6-res-tau-center').innerText = '0.00';
        document.getElementById('z6-res-tau-quarter-tbl').innerText = tauQuarter.toFixed(2);
        document.getElementById('z6-res-tau-wall-tbl').innerText = tauWall.toFixed(2);
        document.getElementById('z6-res-vmax-tbl').innerText = v_max.toFixed(2);
        document.getElementById('z6-res-force-wall-tbl').innerText = F_tau.toFixed(2);

        const w = canvas.width;
        const h = canvas.height;
        const left = { x: 24, y: 22, w: 318, h: 276 };
        const right = { x: 366, y: 22, w: 410, h: 276 };
        const channel = {
            x: left.x + 26,
            y: left.y + 46,
            w: left.w - 52,
            h: left.h - 88
        };
        const cy = channel.y + channel.h / 2;
        const drawR = Math.min(channel.h * 0.43, 92);
        const topWall = cy - drawR;
        const bottomWall = cy + drawR;
        const chart = {
            x: right.x + 54,
            y: right.y + 34,
            w: right.w - 88,
            h: right.h - 68
        };

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

        const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
        bgGrad.addColorStop(0, "#f8fbff");
        bgGrad.addColorStop(1, "#eef6ff");
        ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

        panel(ctx, left.x, left.y, left.w, left.h, "Tok u cijevi", "#0f766e");
        panel(ctx, right.x, right.y, right.w, right.h, "Profil brzine v(r)", "#1d4ed8");

        // Left panel: channel
        const fluidGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(channel.x, topWall, channel.x, bottomWall);
        fluidGrad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(191, 219, 254, 0.55)");
        fluidGrad.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.18)");
        fluidGrad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(191, 219, 254, 0.55)");
        ctx.fillStyle = fluidGrad;
        roundRect(ctx, channel.x, topWall, channel.w, bottomWall - topWall, 18, true, false);

        ctx.fillStyle = "#334155";
        ctx.fillRect(channel.x, topWall - 12, channel.w, 10);
        ctx.fillRect(channel.x, bottomWall + 2, channel.w, 10);

        ctx.strokeStyle = "#94a3b8";
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(channel.x, cy);
        ctx.lineTo(channel.x + channel.w, cy);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.setLineDash([]);

        ctx.font = "12px Inter";
        ctx.fillStyle = "#475569";
        ctx.fillText("os cijevi", channel.x + 6, cy - 8);
        ctx.fillText("stijenka", channel.x + 6, topWall - 16);
        ctx.fillText("stijenka", channel.x + 6, bottomWall + 28);

        // Layer arrows
        for (let i = 0; i <= 8; i++) {
            const y = topWall + (i / 8) * (bottomWall - topWall);
            const r_mm = ((y - cy) / drawR) * R;
            const v = Math.max(0, (beta / (4 * mu)) * ((d_mm/2000)**2 - (r_mm/1000)**2));
            const len = clamp((v / Math.max(v_max, 1e-6)) * 120, 8, 120);
            const alpha = 0.2 + 0.55 * (v / Math.max(v_max, 1e-6));
            drawArrow(ctx, channel.x + 18, y, channel.x + 18 + len, y, `rgba(37, 99, 235, ${alpha})`, 2.5);
        }

        // Particles
        particles.forEach((p) => {
            const r_mm = p.y * R;
            const v = Math.max(0, (beta / (4 * mu)) * ((d_mm/2000)**2 - (r_mm/1000)**2));
            const speedRatio = v / Math.max(v_max, 1e-6);
            p.x += 0.003 + speedRatio * 0.018;
            if (p.x > 1.05) p.x = -0.05;
            const px = channel.x + p.x * channel.w;
            const py = cy + p.y * drawR;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(14, 116, 144, ${0.25 + 0.6 * speedRatio})`;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(px, py, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        });

        // Small formula badge
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.92)";
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#dbeafe";
        roundRect(ctx, channel.x + channel.w - 150, topWall + 14, 136, 34, 10, true, true);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#1e40af";
        ctx.font = "600 12px Inter";
        ctx.fillText("v(r) = vmax (1 - (r/R)^2)", channel.x + channel.w - 140, topWall + 36);

        // Right panel: chart axes
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#94a3b8";
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(chart.x, chart.y);
        ctx.lineTo(chart.x, chart.y + chart.h);
        ctx.lineTo(chart.x + chart.w, chart.y + chart.h);
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.setLineDash([4, 6]);
        for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
            const gy = chart.y + (i / 4) * chart.h;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(chart.x, gy);
            ctx.lineTo(chart.x + chart.w, gy);
            ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.setLineDash([]);

        ctx.font = "11px Inter";
        ctx.fillStyle = "#64748b";
        ctx.fillText("+R", chart.x - 24, chart.y + 4);
        ctx.fillText("0", chart.x - 16, chart.y + chart.h / 2 + 4);
        ctx.fillText("-R", chart.x - 24, chart.y + chart.h);
        ctx.fillText("r", chart.x - 10, chart.y - 8);
        ctx.fillText("v", chart.x + chart.w + 8, chart.y + chart.h + 4);

        // Profile fill and curve
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(chart.x, chart.y);
        for (let i = 0; i <= 120; i++) {
            const t = i / 120;
            const r_mm = R - 2 * R * t;
            const v = Math.max(0, (beta / (4 * mu)) * ((d_mm/2000)**2 - (r_mm/1000)**2));
            const px = chart.x + (v / Math.max(v_max, 1e-6)) * (chart.w - 12);
            const py = chart.y + t * chart.h;
            ctx.lineTo(px, py);
        }
        ctx.lineTo(chart.x, chart.y + chart.h);
        ctx.closePath();
        const chartFill = ctx.createLinearGradient(chart.x, chart.y, chart.x + chart.w, chart.y);
        chartFill.addColorStop(0, "rgba(191, 219, 254, 0.15)");
        chartFill.addColorStop(1, "rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.32)");
        ctx.fillStyle = chartFill;
        ctx.fill();

        ctx.strokeStyle = "#2563eb";
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let i = 0; i <= 120; i++) {
            const t = i / 120;
            const r_mm = R - 2 * R * t;
            const v = Math.max(0, (beta / (4 * mu)) * ((d_mm/2000)**2 - (r_mm/1000)**2));
            const px = chart.x + (v / Math.max(v_max, 1e-6)) * (chart.w - 12);
            const py = chart.y + t * chart.h;
            if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
            else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
        }
        ctx.stroke();

        // Centerline and wall stress bars
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.9)";
        ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(chart.x, chart.y + chart.h / 2);
        ctx.lineTo(chart.x + chart.w, chart.y + chart.h / 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.setLineDash([]);

        const stressBarW = clamp(16 + tauWall * 10, 16, 74);
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.18)";
        ctx.fillRect(chart.x + chart.w - stressBarW, chart.y, stressBarW, 12);
        ctx.fillRect(chart.x + chart.w - stressBarW, chart.y + chart.h - 12, stressBarW, 12);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#b91c1c";
        ctx.font = "600 11px Inter";
        ctx.fillText("visoko tau", chart.x + chart.w - stressBarW - 58, chart.y + 10);
        ctx.fillText("visoko tau", chart.x + chart.w - stressBarW - 58, chart.y + chart.h - 2);

        // Interactive highlight by radial position
        const probeY = probeYRatio === null ? (mousePos ? mousePos.y : null) : (probeYRatio * h);
        if (probeY !== null && probeY >= topWall && probeY <= bottomWall) {
            const r_inspect_mm = ((probeY - cy) / drawR) * R;
            const r_m = r_inspect_mm / 1000;
            const v = Math.max(0, (beta / (4 * mu)) * ((d_mm/2000)**2 - r_m**2));
            const tau = Math.abs(beta * r_m / 2);
            const inspectYChart = chart.y + ((R - r_inspect_mm) / (2 * R)) * chart.h;
            const inspectXChart = chart.x + (v / Math.max(v_max, 1e-6)) * (chart.w - 12);

            tooltip.style.display = 'block';
            tooltip.style.left = ((mousePos ? mousePos.x : chart.x) + 15) + 'px';
            tooltip.style.top = (probeY + 15) + 'px';
            document.getElementById('z6-tt-r').innerText = r_inspect_mm.toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('z6-tt-v').innerText = v.toFixed(3);
            document.getElementById('z6-tt-tau').innerText = tau.toFixed(2);

            ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.42)";
            ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(channel.x, probeY);
            ctx.lineTo(chart.x + chart.w, probeY);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);

            ctx.fillStyle = "#ef4444";
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(channel.x + 14, probeY, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(inspectXChart, inspectYChart, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();

            drawArrow(ctx, channel.x + channel.w - 86, probeY, channel.x + channel.w - 86 + Math.min(58, 14 + tau * 9), probeY, "#ef4444", 2.5);
        } else {
            tooltip.style.display = 'none';
        }

        // Bottom legends
        ctx.fillStyle = "#64748b";
        ctx.font = "12px Inter";
        ctx.fillText("sporije uz stijenku", channel.x, left.y + left.h - 18);
        ctx.fillText("najbrže na osi", channel.x + channel.w - 92, left.y + left.h - 18);
        ctx.fillText("parabolični profil", chart.x, right.y + right.h - 14);
        ctx.fillText("tau raste prema stijenci", chart.x + chart.w - 138, right.y + right.h - 14);

    }

    [muS, betaS, dS, lS].forEach((slider) => slider.addEventListener('input', draw));
    window.addEventListener('resize', draw);
    draw();
})();
</script>
````

### Zadatak 5 — Blok na kosini {.unnumbered}

(2500 SPFM – 1.71) Blok kvadratnog presjeka težine 1,1 kN, duljine bridova 250 mm klizi
kosinom koja s horizontalnom osi zatvara kut od 20° po sloju ulja debljine 6 μm. Ukoliko
pretpostavimo linearan profil brzine i konstantnu debljinu sloja ulja, potrebno je odrediti
ustaljenu brzinu bloka. Dinamička viskoznost ulja iznosi 7 mPa·s.

<div class="zadano-grid">
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Zadano</span>
<span class="zadano-text">$G = 1100\ \text{N}$, $a = 0{,}25\ \text{m}$, $\alpha = 20°$, $\delta_u = 6\cdot 10^{-6}\ \text{m}$, $\mu = 0{,}007\ \text{Pa\,s}$</span>
</div>
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Odrediti</span>
<span class="zadano-text">ustaljena brzina klizanja $v_B$</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="rjesenje-label">Rješenje</div>

1. **Tangencijalna komponenta težine** (vuče blok niz kosinu):
$$F_\tau = G\sin\alpha = 1100\cdot\sin 20° = 376\ \text{N}$$
2. **Ravnoteža sila:** viskozna sila $F_v = \mu\,(v_B/\delta_u)\cdot a^2$ jednaka je $F_\tau$
3. **Brzina bloka:**
$$v_B = \frac{F_\tau\,\delta_u}{\mu\,a^2} = \frac{376\cdot 6\cdot 10^{-6}}{0{,}007\cdot 0{,}25^2} = 5{,}16\ \text{m/s}$$

````{=html}
<script>
(function() {
    const z7c = document.getElementById('z7-canvas');
    if (!z7c) return;
    const z7ctx = z7c.getContext('2d');
    const z7zc = document.getElementById('z7-zoom-canvas');
    const z7zctx = z7zc.getContext('2d');
    const z7aS = document.getElementById('z7-alpha');
    const z7mS = document.getElementById('z7-mu');
    const z7dS = document.getElementById('z7-delta');

    const z7BaseW = 760;
    const z7BaseH = 420;
    const z7ZoomW = 160;
    const z7ZoomH = 90;
    const blockWeight = 1100;
    const blockSide = 0.25;

    let z7State = null;

    function setText(id, value) {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.textContent = value;
    }

    function clamp(value, min, max) {
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
    }

    function prepareCanvas(canvas, ctx, logicalWidth, logicalHeight) {
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const displayWidth = Math.max(Math.round(rect.width) || logicalWidth, 80);
        const displayHeight = Math.max(Math.round(rect.height) || logicalHeight, 40);
        const ratio = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        const pixelWidth = Math.max(1, Math.round(displayWidth * ratio));
        const pixelHeight = Math.max(1, Math.round(displayHeight * ratio));

        if (canvas.width !== pixelWidth || canvas.height !== pixelHeight) {
            canvas.width = pixelWidth;
            canvas.height = pixelHeight;
        }

        const scaleX = displayWidth / logicalWidth;
        const scaleY = displayHeight / logicalHeight;
        ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        ctx.setTransform(scaleX * ratio, 0, 0, scaleY * ratio, 0, 0);
        ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    }

    function roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r, fill, stroke) {
        const rr = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x + rr, y);
        ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, rr);
        ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, rr);
        ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, rr);
        ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, rr);
        ctx.closePath();
        if (fill) ctx.fill();
        if (stroke) ctx.stroke();
    }

    function drawArrow(ctx, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, label) {
        const headLength = 10;
        const angle = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
        ctx.strokeStyle = color;
        ctx.fillStyle = color;
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
        ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x2, y2);
        ctx.lineTo(x2 - headLength * Math.cos(angle - Math.PI / 6), y2 - headLength * Math.sin(angle - Math.PI / 6));
        ctx.lineTo(x2 - headLength * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI / 6), y2 - headLength * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI / 6));
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();

        if (label) {
            ctx.font = '700 12px Inter';
            ctx.fillText(label, x2 + (x2 >= x1 ? 8 : -34), y2 - 8);
        }
    }

    function getValues() {
        const alphaDeg = parseFloat(z7aS.value);
        const alpha = alphaDeg * Math.PI / 180;
        const muMilli = parseFloat(z7mS.value);
        const mu = muMilli / 1000;
        const deltaMicron = parseFloat(z7dS.value);
        const delta = deltaMicron / 1e6;
        const Ft = blockWeight * Math.sin(alpha);
        const v = (Ft * delta) / (mu * blockSide * blockSide);
        const Fv = mu * (v / delta) * blockSide * blockSide;
        const tau = mu * (v / delta);

        return { alphaDeg, alpha, muMilli, mu, deltaMicron, delta, Ft, v, Fv, tau };
    }

    function updateZ7State() {
        z7State = getValues();

        setText('z7-v-alpha', z7State.alphaDeg.toFixed(0));
        setText('z7-v-mu', z7State.muMilli.toFixed(0));
        setText('z7-v-delta', z7State.deltaMicron.toFixed(0));
        setText('z7-stage-v', z7State.v.toFixed(2));
        setText('z7-stage-delta', z7State.deltaMicron.toFixed(0));
        setText('z7-res-v', z7State.v.toFixed(2));
        setText('z7-res-fg', z7State.Ft.toFixed(1));
        setText('z7-res-fv', z7State.Fv.toFixed(1));
        setText('z7-res-tau', z7State.tau.toFixed(1));
        setText('z7-balance-fg', z7State.Ft.toFixed(1));
        setText('z7-balance-fv', z7State.Fv.toFixed(1));
        setText('z7-stage-balance', 'F_tang = F_v');
        setText('z7-eq-vals', `v_B = (${z7State.Ft.toFixed(1)} · ${z7State.deltaMicron.toFixed(0)}×10⁻⁶) / (${z7State.mu.toFixed(3)} · 0.25²) = ${z7State.v.toFixed(2)} m/s`);

        const tauAbs = Math.abs(z7State.tau);
        if (tauAbs >= 1000) {
            setText('z7-res-tau', (z7State.tau / 1000).toFixed(2));
            setText('z7-res-tau-unit', 'kPa');
        } else {
            setText('z7-res-tau', z7State.tau.toFixed(1));
            setText('z7-res-tau-unit', 'Pa');
        }

        const refForce = Math.max(z7State.Ft, z7State.Fv, 1);
        document.getElementById('z7-bar-fg').style.width = `${(z7State.Ft / refForce * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
        document.getElementById('z7-bar-fv').style.width = `${(z7State.Fv / refForce * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;

        let logicText = 'Otpor filma i komponenta težine upravo se izjednačuju u umjerenom režimu gibanja.';
        if (z7State.v > 40) {
            logicText = 'Kosina je dovoljno pogonska ili je film dovoljno "mekan" da blok treba veliku brzinu kako bi razvio potreban viskozni otpor.';
        } else if (z7State.v < 8) {
            logicText = 'Viskoznost je relativno jaka ili je film vrlo tanak, pa se ravnoteža postiže već pri maloj brzini klizanja.';
        }
        setText('z7-logic-summary', logicText);
        setText('z7-explainer', `Komponenta težine niz kosinu sada iznosi ${z7State.Ft.toFixed(1)} N. U filmu debljine ${z7State.deltaMicron.toFixed(0)} μm mora se razviti jednako velik viskozni otpor, pa blok klizi stalnom brzinom ${z7State.v.toFixed(2)} m/s. Ako povećamo α ili δ, brzina raste; ako povećamo μ, potrebna brzina pada. ${logicText}`);
        drawStage(z7State);
        drawZoom(z7State);
    }

    function drawStage(values) {
        prepareCanvas(z7c, z7ctx, z7BaseW, z7BaseH);

        const bg = z7ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, z7BaseH);
        bg.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
        bg.addColorStop(1, '#edf5ff');
        z7ctx.fillStyle = bg;
        z7ctx.fillRect(0, 0, z7BaseW, z7BaseH);

        z7ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12)';
        z7ctx.fillRect(530, 28, 2, 364);

        const originX = 86;
        const originY = 112;
        const slopeLength = 430;
        const blockW = 92;
        const blockH = 58;
        const filmGap = 10;
        const planeThickness = 18;

        const blockAlong = 190;

        z7ctx.save();
        z7ctx.translate(originX, originY);
        z7ctx.rotate(values.alpha);

        const planeGrad = z7ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, planeThickness + 12);
        planeGrad.addColorStop(0, '#64748b');
        planeGrad.addColorStop(1, '#334155');
        z7ctx.fillStyle = planeGrad;
        roundRect(z7ctx, -36, 0, slopeLength + 90, planeThickness, 9, true, false);

        const oilGrad = z7ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -filmGap, 0, 0);
        oilGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.42)');
        oilGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(191, 219, 254, 0.85)');
        z7ctx.fillStyle = oilGrad;
        roundRect(z7ctx, -24, -filmGap, slopeLength + 70, filmGap, 6, true, false);

        z7ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
        z7ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            const x = 26 + i * 88;
            z7ctx.beginPath();
            z7ctx.moveTo(x, -4);
            z7ctx.lineTo(x + 42, -4);
            z7ctx.stroke();
        }

        z7ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12)';
        roundRect(z7ctx, blockAlong + 6, -blockH - filmGap + 8, blockW, blockH, 14, true, false);

        const blockGrad = z7ctx.createLinearGradient(blockAlong, -blockH - filmGap, blockAlong, -filmGap);
        blockGrad.addColorStop(0, '#64748b');
        blockGrad.addColorStop(1, '#334155');
        z7ctx.fillStyle = blockGrad;
        roundRect(z7ctx, blockAlong, -blockH - filmGap, blockW, blockH, 14, true, false);
        z7ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)';
        roundRect(z7ctx, blockAlong + 10, -blockH - filmGap + 8, blockW - 20, 8, 4, true, false);

        const centerX = blockAlong + blockW / 2;
        const centerY = -blockH / 2 - filmGap;
        drawArrow(z7ctx, centerX - 6, centerY + 16, centerX + 72, centerY + 16, '#ef4444', 'G sin α');
        drawArrow(z7ctx, centerX + 6, centerY - 10, centerX - 72, centerY - 10, '#2563eb', 'F_v');
        drawArrow(z7ctx, centerX - 10, centerY - 30, centerX + 70, centerY - 30, '#16a34a', 'v_B');

        z7ctx.strokeStyle = '#0f766e';
        z7ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        z7ctx.beginPath();
        z7ctx.moveTo(blockAlong + blockW + 18, -filmGap);
        z7ctx.lineTo(blockAlong + blockW + 18, 0);
        z7ctx.stroke();
        z7ctx.beginPath();
        z7ctx.moveTo(blockAlong + blockW + 12, -filmGap);
        z7ctx.lineTo(blockAlong + blockW + 24, -filmGap);
        z7ctx.moveTo(blockAlong + blockW + 12, 0);
        z7ctx.lineTo(blockAlong + blockW + 24, 0);
        z7ctx.stroke();
        z7ctx.fillStyle = '#0f766e';
        z7ctx.font = '700 12px Inter';
        z7ctx.fillText('δ', blockAlong + blockW + 28, -2);

        z7ctx.restore();

        z7ctx.strokeStyle = '#2563eb';
        z7ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        z7ctx.beginPath();
        z7ctx.arc(originX, originY, 42, 0, values.alpha, false);
        z7ctx.stroke();
        z7ctx.fillStyle = '#1d4ed8';
        z7ctx.font = '700 14px Inter';
        z7ctx.fillText(`α = ${values.alphaDeg.toFixed(0)}°`, originX + 48, originY - 6);

        z7ctx.fillStyle = '#475569';
        z7ctx.font = '13px Inter';
        z7ctx.fillText('Film ulja je nacrtan uvećano da bi se jasno vidio profil brzine i razmak δ.', 54, 382);
    }

    function drawZoom(values) {
        prepareCanvas(z7zc, z7zctx, z7ZoomW, z7ZoomH);

        const zoomBg = z7zctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, z7ZoomH);
        zoomBg.addColorStop(0, '#f8fbff');
        zoomBg.addColorStop(1, '#eef6ff');
        z7zctx.fillStyle = zoomBg;
        z7zctx.fillRect(0, 0, z7ZoomW, z7ZoomH);

        z7zctx.fillStyle = '#1e293b';
        z7zctx.fillRect(0, 10, z7ZoomW, 12);
        z7zctx.fillRect(0, 68, z7ZoomW, 12);

        const filmGrad = z7zctx.createLinearGradient(0, 22, 0, 68);
        filmGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(191, 219, 254, 0.95)');
        filmGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.35)');
        z7zctx.fillStyle = filmGrad;
        z7zctx.fillRect(0, 22, z7ZoomW, 46);

        const arrowScale = clamp(values.v / 12, 0.4, 6);
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            const t = i / 4;
            const y = 60 - t * 28;
            const len = 16 + t * 18 * arrowScale;
            z7zctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(37, 99, 235, ${0.35 + 0.14 * i})`;
            z7zctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
            z7zctx.beginPath();
            z7zctx.moveTo(12, y);
            z7zctx.lineTo(12 + Math.min(len, 116), y);
            z7zctx.stroke();
        }

        z7zctx.strokeStyle = '#0f766e';
        z7zctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
        z7zctx.beginPath();
        z7zctx.moveTo(134, 22);
        z7zctx.lineTo(134, 68);
        z7zctx.stroke();
        z7zctx.beginPath();
        z7zctx.moveTo(128, 22);
        z7zctx.lineTo(140, 22);
        z7zctx.moveTo(128, 68);
        z7zctx.lineTo(140, 68);
        z7zctx.stroke();

        z7zctx.fillStyle = '#0f766e';
        z7zctx.font = '700 11px Inter';
        z7zctx.fillText('δ', 144, 47);
        z7zctx.fillStyle = '#475569';
        z7zctx.font = '11px Inter';
        z7zctx.fillText('v = 0', 102, 82);
        z7zctx.fillText('v_B', 118, 18);
    }

    [z7aS, z7mS, z7dS].forEach((slider) => slider.addEventListener('input', updateZ7State));
    updateZ7State();
})();
</script>
````
